content.short: Yoroi Wallet is a premier, non-custodial light wallet for Cardano providing fast and secure ADA management.
content.description: Yoroi Wallet is one of the most established and trusted light wallets in the Cardano ecosystem, developed by EMURGO. Designed for both desktop and mobile platforms, Yoroi provides a fast, secure, and user-friendly gateway for managing ADA and other Cardano native tokens. As a non-custodial wallet, it ensures that users maintain full control over their private keys while easily participating in ADA staking and Project Catalyst governance. Yoroi is optimized for everyday use, offering a reliable experience that prioritizes both high-level security and technical accessibility for all users.
content.meta: Yoroi Wallet is a trusted Cardano light wallet for secure ADA management, staking, and governance. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
